devon.desc: This {0} dreams of owning their own personal computer so they can start a blog full of pictures of toast.

ren.name: Ren
ren.desc: Every {0} has this unshakable feeling that his life's already happened and he's just watching it unfold from a memory.

frankie.name: Frankie
frankie.desc: There's nothing {0}s are more proud of than their thick, dignified eyebrows.

banhi.name: Banhi
banhi.desc: The "cool loner" vibes that radiate off a {0} never fail to make the colony swoon.

ada.name: Ada
ada.desc: {0}s enjoy writing poetry in their downtime. Dark poetry.

hassan.name: Hassan
hassan.desc: If someone says something nice to a {0} he'll think about it nonstop for no less than three weeks.

stinky.name: Stinky
stinky.desc: This {0} has never been invited to a party, which is a shame. His dance moves are incredible.

joshua.name: Joshua
joshua.desc: {0}s are precious goobers. Other Duplicants are strangely incapable of cursing in a {0}'s presence.

liam.name: Liam
liam.desc: No matter how much this {0} scrubs, he can never truly feel clean.

abe.name: Abe
abe.desc: {0}s are sweet, delicate flowers. They need to be treated gingerly, with great consideration for their feelings.

burt.name: Burt
burt.desc: This {0} always feels great after a bubble bath and a good long cry.

travaldo.name: Travaldo
travaldo.desc: A {0}'s monotonous voice and lack of facial expression makes it impossible for others to tell when he's messing with them.

harold.name: Harold
harold.desc: Get a bunch of {0}s together in a room, and you'll have... a bunch of {0}s together in a room.

max.name: Max
max.desc: At any given moment a {0} is viscerally reliving ten different humiliating memories.

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.desc: {0}s have exceptionally large hearts and express their emotions most efficiently by yelling.

otto.name: Otto
otto.desc: {0}s always insult people by accident and generally exist in a perpetual state of deep regret.

turner.name: Turner
turner.desc: This {0} is paralyzed by the knowledge that others have memories and perceptions of them they can't control.

nikola.name: Nikola
nikola.desc: This {0} once claimed he could build a laser so powerful it would rip the colony in half. No one asked him to prove it.

meep.name: Meep
meep.desc: {0}s have a face only a two tonne Printing Pod could love.

ari.name: Ari
ari.desc: {0}s tend to space out from time to time, but they always pay attention when it counts.

jean.name: Jean
jean.desc: Just because {0}s are a little slow doesn't mean they can't suffer from soul-crushing existential crises.

camille.name: Camille
camille.desc: This {0} loves anything that makes her feel nostalgic, including things that haven't aged well.

ashkan.name: Ashkan
ashkan.desc: {0}s have what can only be described as a "seriously infectious giggle".

steve.name: Steve
steve.desc: This {0} is convinced that he has psychic powers. And he knows exactly what his friends think about that.

amari.name: Amari
amari.desc: {0}s likes to keep the peace. Ironically, they're a riot at parties.

pei.name: Pei
pei.desc: Every {0} spends at least half the day pretending that they remember what they came into this room for.

quinn.name: Quinn
quinn.desc: This {0}'s favorite genre of music is "festive power ballad".

jorge.name: Jorge
jorge.desc: {0} loves his new colony, even if their collective body odor makes his eyes water.

freyja.name: Freyja
freyja.desc: This {0} has never stopped anyone from eating yellow snow.

chip.name: Chip
chip.desc: This {0} is extremely good at guessing their friends' passwords.

edwiredo.name: Edwiredo
edwiredo.desc: This {0} once rolled his eye so hard that he powered himself off and on again.

gizmo.name: Gizmo
gizmo.desc: {0}s love nothing more than a big juicy info dump.

steela.name: Steela
steela.desc: {0}s aren't programmed to put up with nonsense, but they do enjoy the occasional shenanigan.

sonyar.name: Sonyar
sonyar.desc: {0}s would sooner burn down the colony than read an instruction manual.

ulti.name: Ulti
ulti.desc: This {0}'s favorite dance move is The Robot. They don't get why others think that's funny.

higby.name: Higby
higby.desc: This {0}'s got a song in his heart. Now if only he could remember how it goes.

maya.name: Maya
maya.desc: This {0} got her hand crushed in a pneumatic door once. It was the most alive she's ever felt.

sena.name: Sena
sena.desc: {0}s only care about three things: gold accents, true crime, and the advancement of nuclear physics.

food_quality.expectation_tooltip:
Each Duplicant has a minimum quality of Food they'll tolerate eating.

food_quality.foodquality_expectation: This Duplicant is content to eat Food with a Food Quality of {0} or higher

qualityoflife.name: Morale Requirements
qualityoflife.expectation_tooltip:
The more responsibilities and stressors a Duplicant has, the more they will desire additional leisure time and improved amenities.

Failing to keep a Duplicant's Morale at or above their Morale Need means they will not be able to unwind, causing them Stress over time.

attributes.unprofessional_desc: This Duplicant has no discernible skills
attributes.profession_desc:
Expertise is determined by a Duplicant's highest Attribute

Duplicants develop higher expectations as their Expertise level increases

scaldingthreshold.name: Scalding Threshold
scaldingthreshold.desc: Determines the Temperature at which a Duplicant will get burned.

scoldingthreshold.name: Frostbite Threshold
scoldingthreshold.desc: Determines the Temperature at which a Duplicant will get frostbitten.

luminescence.name: Luminescence

doctoredlevel.name: Treatment Received Effect
doctoredlevel.desc:
Duplicants who receive medical care while in a Sick Bay or Disease Clinic will gain the Treatment Received effect

This effect reduces the severity of Disease symptoms

sneezyness.desc: Determines how frequently a Duplicant sneezes.

germresistance.name: Germ Resistance
germresistance.desc: Duplicants with a higher Germ Resistance rating are less likely to contract germ-based Diseases.

happinessdelta.name: Happiness

Duplicants accumulate Rads in areas with Radiation and recover at very slow rates

Open the Radiation Overlay to view current Rad readings

caring.name: Medicine

ranching.desc: Determines how efficiently a Duplicant tends Critters.

Determines how quickly a Duplicant retains or loses body Heat in any given area.

It is the sum of a Duplicant's Equipment and their natural Insulation values.

decorradius.name: Decor Radius

A Decor Morale Bonus allows Duplicants to receive Morale boosts from lower Decor values.

Maintaining high Morale will allow Duplicants to learn more Skills.

A Food Morale Bonus allows Duplicants to receive Morale boosts from lower quality Food.

Maintaining high Morale will allow Duplicants to learn more Skills.

hygiene.name: Hygiene
hygiene.desc: Affects a Duplicant's sense of cleanliness.

qualityoflife.name: Morale
qualityoflife.desc:
A Duplicant's Morale must exceed their Morale Need, or they'll begin to accumulate Stress.

Morale can be increased by providing Duplicants higher quality Food, allotting more Downtime in
the colony schedule, or building better Bathrooms and Bedrooms for them to live in.
